examples.description: Read the composition for its scene, clip and asset ids before editing

description: Read the current composition: scenes in order (with derived start times and generation status; length_estimated: true marks a scene sized by an estimate because its video file reported no length), tracks (id, role, name, locked, muted) and clips, overlays, caption count, total duration, and the assets (the ids every asset_id argument takes). Call when you need fresh truth after edits.
